preconditions.expression: n >= 2 and m >= 1 and k >= 2 and m * k <= n
preconditions.description: Input constraints: n is the array length, m is the beauty constant, k is the number of subarrays, and m*k must not exceed n.
The array a must have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(-1e9 <= x <= 1e9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in a must be between -1e9 and 1e9.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the maximum possible sum of beauties of the k subarrays.

postconditions.expression: len(partition_indices) == k - 1 and all(1 <= p <= n - 1 for p in partition_indices) and all(p1 < p2 for p1, p2 in zip(partition_indices, partition_indices[1:]))
postconditions.description: The second line of output must contain exactly k-1 integers representing valid partition indices, strictly increasing and within bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(len(subarray) >= m for subarray in get_subarrays(a, partition_indices))
postconditions.description: Each subarray in the partition must have at least m elements.

postconditions.expression: sum_of_beauties == sum(beauty(subarray) for subarray in get_subarrays(a, partition_indices))
postconditions.description: The sum of beauties of the subarrays in the partition must equal the first line of output.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a postcondition ensuring the sum of beauties is maximized among all valid partitions.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: Your need to split the array a into exactly k subarrays such that: ... The sum of all beauties of k subarrays is maximum possible.

candidate_issues.instruction: Replace `sum_of_beauties == max_possible_sum` with an expression that explicitly captures the maximization requirement (e.g., `sum_of_beauties == max(sum(beauty(subarray) for subarray in valid_partitions(a, k, m)))`).
Add a postcondition ensuring the partition is valid (i.e., all elements are assigned to exactly one subarray).
candidate_issues.task_evidence: Each element from a belongs to exactly one subarray.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a postcondition ensuring the partition is contiguous (i.e., subarrays are continuous subsequences of a).
candidate_issues.task_evidence: An array b is called to be a subarray of a if it forms a continuous subsequence of a.
